name: Steel
summary: Open-source browser API for agents with a managed cloud. It runs Chrome sessions you control over CDP with Puppeteer, Playwright or Selenium, and handles sessions, proxies, fingerprints and page-to-markdown conversion.
facts: Docker image, Docker Compose, Railway, Render
Free $30 one-time credit; Scale $250/mo; $0.08–0.10 per browser-hour
watchOut: Stealth browser is Enterprise-only in the cloud
Short session cap on the free plan
